metadata.task: Move the wheelchair through the corridor without colliding with patients or furniture.

plan.goal: Navigate the robot through the hospital corridor to a safe location without colliding with static structures (furniture) or dynamic entities (patients).

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Verify the robot's initial localization state and confirm the existence of the target corridor and any potential obstacles (patients/furniture) within the planned path.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at a default spawn location (e.g., Main Entrance or Reception). No active navigation goal. World state includes static structures and potentially dynamic patients in corridors.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is localized. A valid path to the corridor has been computed. Obstacles (patients/furniture) have been detected or the path has been validated against the costmap.

grounded_skills.reason: Robot requires a valid pose estimate to execute navigation. The robot has IMU but lacks visual/depth sensors for autonomous SLAM; manual initialization or map-based localization is required.

The robot lacks active range sensors (Lidar/Depth) to dynamically detect obstacles like patients or furniture. The planner must rely on the pre-existing occupancy grid (costmap) of the hospital to identify static obstacles and assume dynamic obstacles are accounted for in the costmap or require teleoperated avoidance.

The robot is fixed-base and relies on remote operation. Navigation to the 'corridor' (a semantic location) is the primary motion primitive. Since the robot cannot fly or walk, 'navigate_to_room' implies moving the base to the specified coordinates within the map.

constraints: Robot is fixed-base (cannot move independently). All motion commands must be executed via remote operation (teleoperation).

execution_summary.expected_outcome: The robot will be localized, the corridor path will be planned based on the static map (avoiding furniture), and the robot will be teleoperated to the corridor. Collision with patients is mitigated by the assumption that the costmap includes dynamic obstacles or that the operator manually avoids them during teleoperation.
